'''Therin Lugay''' lives in the town of [[Mardecin]] in [[Amadicia]].

== Activities ==
He owes [[Ronde Macura]] a favor since she cured him of a fever that killed twenty-three the previous winter. She hires him to transport [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] to Tar Valon while they are drugged with Forkroot. When he finds them unconscious in their house he decides to see the world with the money he was paid.{{ref/book|5|10}}
